title: Should iShares Select Dividend ETF (DVY) Be on Your Investing Radar?
author: Na
description: The iShares Select Dividend ETF (DVY) is a passively managed fund with $23.65 billion in assets offering exposure to large-cap value stocks. With a 0.38% expense ratio, 3.29% dividend yield, and 17.8% year-to-date return, it presents a medium-risk option for dividend-focused investors. However, alternatives like SCHD and VTV offer lower expense ratios, earning DVY a Zacks ETF Rank of 3 (Hold).
